test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

He does not buy shirts.

options.text: Shirts are not bought by him.
Shirts are not brought by him.
Shirts were not been bought by him.
Shirts were not bought by him.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Shirts are not bought by him. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in the active voice with the subject "**he**" performing the action of "**buying shirts**."
 
• To convert it into passive voice, we need to make the object "**shirts**" the subject of the sentence and add a form of "**be**" before the main verb "**bought**."
 
• The past participle form of "**buy**" is "**bought**," which is used in passive voice sentences.
 
• The sentence in passive voice becomes "*Shirts are not bought by him.*"

Hence, **option 1** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2**: The sentence changes the verb "buy" to "bring," which changes the meaning of the sentence.
 
• **Option 3**: The sentence uses the incorrect form of "been" after "were," making it grammatically incorrect.
 
• **Option 4**: The sentence is grammatically correct but conveys a negative meaning of the original sentence.
